chunks: My father narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain ibn Abil Khaťťāb, from someone who narrated to him, from Sufyān Al-Jarīfyān Al-Jarīri, from his father, from Abī Rāfi’, from his father, from his grandfather, from Abī Dhar Al-Ghifāri, who said:

The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) ordered me to love Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.). Therefore, I love them and I love those who love them because of the Messenger of Allāh’s love for (Ḥasan and Ḥusain (a.s.)).
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet command regarding the love of Hasan and Husayn?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the foundational Shia doctrine of *Al-Wala'* (loyalty) by linking the love of the Imams directly to the Prophet’s command, thereby establishing it as an act of devotion to the Prophet himself. It underscores the theological significance of Abū Dharr, a prominent companion, as a transmitter of this specific directive, reinforcing the continuity of prophetic authority through the Ahl al-Bayt. The hadith serves as a key evidence for the obligation of loving the Imams as a means of following the Sunnah.
